armor.name: Titanium Armor
armor.why: This is the premium ore armor for pre-mech melee because it brings strong defense and offensive scaling together.

armor.name: Adamantite Armor
armor.why: Adamantite is the world-variant fallback and still gives melee everything it needs to break into mech fights.

accessories.name: Warrior Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The raw melee damage bonus is immediate and efficient, which makes it the easiest offensive slot to justify in this phase.

accessories.name: Angel Wings
accessories.source: Crafted (25 Souls of Flight + 10 Souls of Light + 20 Feathers, at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
accessories.why: First flight - the biggest early-Hardmode mobility jump.

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Knockback immunity remains one of the most reliable survival upgrades you can carry into Hardmode.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert players still get a lot out of the dash even after wings enter the build.

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.source: Crafted from Band of Regeneration and Philosopher's Stone.
accessories.why: Steady life regen and a shorter healing-potion cooldown keep you topped up.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: This is still the easiest always-worth-it potion in a phase where every boss hits much harder.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction scales beautifully once Hardmode boss patterns start punishing every mistake.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A flat damage increase is especially valuable when you are trying to shorten difficult mech attempts.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: Extra max life gives you more room to survive burst damage while learning early Hardmode fights.

armor.name: Titanium Armor

accessories.name: Angel Wings

accessories.why: First flight - the biggest early-Hardmode mobility jump.

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: You still need strong horizontal movement to keep distance and reposition between volley windows.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Knockback immunity still saves runs, especially in tighter arenas or while learning the bosses.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu

accessories.why: A dash to dodge attacks and reposition in a pinch.

buffs.name: Archery Potion

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Saving ammo matters a lot once Hardmode weapons and special arrows start getting expensive.

buffs.name: Ammo Box

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Ranger still benefits from the universal defense bump because avoiding every hit is unrealistic.

armor.name: Forbidden Armor

accessories.name: Sorcerer Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The damage boost is immediate and efficient, which is exactly what mage wants from an early Hardmode accessory slot.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Mana on hit plus better star pickup smooths out one of mage's biggest pain points during long boss attempts.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Auto-potion support keeps your spell uptime higher and reduces how often you get punished while juggling resources.

accessories.name: Angel Wings
accessories.source: Crafted (25 Souls of Flight + 10 Souls of Light + 20 Feathers, at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
accessories.why: First flight - the biggest early-Hardmode mobility jump.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Knockback immunity is still extremely useful when a fragile class gets clipped during a dangerous pattern.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu in Expert worlds.
accessories.why: A dash to dodge attacks and reposition in a pinch.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: This is the cleanest direct magic damage buff and the easiest class-specific consumable to justify.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Sustain matters a lot once your stronger Hardmode spells begin chewing through mana pools.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: It is a free pre-fight magic buff, so there is very little reason not to pick it up before boss attempts.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Mage still needs baseline defense because one mistake can turn into a very short attempt.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Sanguine Staff

weapons.why: Summons fast Sanguine Bat minions; obtainable early Hardmode with no mechanical boss required.

weapons.name: Spider Staff

weapons.why: Summons Spider minions that inflict Acid Venom; Spider Fangs drop from Hardmode Black Recluses.

weapons.name: Queen Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 24 Spider Fang at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Early Hardmode sentry summoning a Spider Turret that lobs bouncing egg projectiles.

weapons.name: Firecracker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
weapons.why: Wall of Flesh drop whose tag detonates for a large burst of minion damage.

weapons.name: Tempest Staff

weapons.name: Barnacle Staff

weapons.why: Hardmode fished sentry summoning a hanging barnacle that poisons enemies.

weapons.why: Summons a Frost Wave and applies Frostburn to struck enemies.

weapons.name: Electric Eel

weapons.why: Duke Fishron drop with long range that chains lightning between enemies.

weapons.name: Abigail's Flower

weapons.why: Summons Abigail, a single ghost minion that grows stronger with each re-summon.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 17 Hellstone Bars at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.

weapons.name: Spinal Tap
weapons.source: Crafted (90 Bone + 55 Cobweb at a Work Bench)
weapons.why: Crafted from Bones and offers long range with piercing.

weapons.name: Ballista Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that fires high-damage piercing bolts.

armor.name: Spider Armor
armor.why: This is the straightforward pre-mech best-in-slot armor because the extra minions matter more than almost anything else.

accessories.name: Summoner Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: Summoner gets a clean damage spike here, which is why this is the first offensive accessory you slot in.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor at night
accessories.why: An extra minion slot is one of the most efficient upgrades any summoner can buy in this phase.

accessories.name: Angel Wings
accessories.source: Crafted (25 Souls of Flight + 10 Souls of Light + 20 Feathers, at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
accessories.why: First flight - the biggest early-Hardmode mobility jump.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: Whip speed is a simple but meaningful quality-of-life increase for the parts of summoner gameplay you control directly.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Knockback immunity keeps your whip windows and recovery movement from getting interrupted at the worst time.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu in Expert worlds.
accessories.why: A dash to dodge attacks and reposition in a pinch.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion is too good to pass up, so this is the baseline summoner buff for every serious boss attempt.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: The free extra minion slot stacks perfectly with your potion support and should be active whenever possible.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner is fragile, so the universal defense potion stays mandatory in practice.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction is especially helpful for the squishiest class while you learn aggressive Hardmode fights.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense reduction is too strong to ignore, which makes this the best melee weapon imbue for the phase.

buffs.name: Flask of Cursed Flames
buffs.source: Brewed at an Imbuing Station (Cursed Flames)
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with Cursed Inferno.

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
